The work under this contract covers Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for one yer. 2. Bidder functionality service centre should be near consignee location. Documentary evidence shoul d be up loaded. 10. However, w hile terminating the contract, if any payment is due to the contractor for service already performed in term s the department shall be final. 11. The department reserves the right to obtain the service from other sources. 12.
